purpose: The tiered register of every source the research is allowed to count, and what a mention from it is worth. It exists because the corpus had drifted: Time Out, The Infatuation and DesignMyNight alone account for roughly a third of all source records, so 'cross-referenced across many sources' often meant three publications and their echoes.
howToUse: scripts/build-evidence.mjs reads this to tier every mention. A domain that is not listed here is counted as tier C with a warning, so an unknown source is visible rather than silently weighted.

A.label: Judged, dated ranking
A.what: A named panel or inspectorate published a ranked or starred list with a YEAR on it. The strongest single signal, because it is falsifiable and re-run annually.
A.caution: A star is a claim with a date. Verify the year before writing 'holds a Michelin star' - Hakkasan and Yauatcha were both written as current after losing theirs.

B.label: Editorial publication
B.what: A masthead with editors, paying writers to visit. Broad and useful, but this tier is over-represented and its members copy each other.

C.label: Independent blog or specialist
C.what: One or two people writing from their own visits, or a single-subject specialist. Often earlier and more specific than the publications, and much closer to what a local would actually say.

D.label: Video
D.what: YouTube and TikTok creators. Currently ZERO sources across all 27 topics, which is the single largest gap in the corpus.
D.method: Venue names come from the description and chapter timestamps first - creators list them - and from the transcript only as a fallback.

E.label: Community
E.what: Reddit threads and forum posts where named people argue about where to eat.
E.whyNotAnAggregator: The aggregator rule below bans TripAdvisor and Yelp because a volume-ranked list lets ONE crowd-sourced ranking pose as several independent opinions. A Reddit thread is the opposite: individual, attributable, argued, and frequently contradicts the published lists. Counted per THREAD, never per comment, so one busy thread cannot outweigh a publication.

F.label: Venue's own site (fact check only)
F.what: The restaurant's own website or its hotel group's page. Used to verify address, postcode, price and which branches are open. NEVER counted toward consensus - a venue recommending itself is not evidence.

rules.distinctDomains: Support is counted in distinct DOMAINS, never in URLs. Two lists from one publication is one opinion.
rules.tierSpread: An entry needs 2+ domains across 2+ TIERS, or one tier-A award. Five publications agreeing is weaker evidence than a publication, a blogger and a video agreeing - they read each other.
rules.syndication: Where one outlet REPORTS another's ranking, that is the original source, not a second one. Time Out publishes 'X has been crowned by the Telegraph' constantly; counting both double-counts a single judgement.
rules.recency: A mention older than 36 months still counts but is flagged. A venue with no mention inside 24 months is a closure candidate - the check that caught Oklava and Jinjuu.
rules.aggregators: TripAdvisor, Yelp, OpenTable, Wanderlog, Trip101, restaurantguru, Corner and similar are EXCLUDED. They rank by user volume, repeat each other, and dominate search results.

blocked.note: Refuse the fetcher. A dead source inflates apparent breadth without adding any. Kept here so the same URLs are not retried every topic.
blocked.keepInCorpusNote: Blocked, but the seeded URLs STAY in data/consensus/*.json. purge-dead-sources.mjs strips empty sources from blocked domains; these are exempt, so the refusal shows up in every run rather than being quietly forgotten. See data/reference/hotel-corpus.md - the Telegraph pages are real editorial lists we are simply priced out of, and the URLs remain the record of what the SERP returned.

substituteCaveats.guide.michelin.com: STARS ONLY. The substitute is the list of Michelin-STARRED restaurants, so it cannot surface a Bib Gourmand - Lai Rai (Vietnamese, Peckham, Bib 2026) does not appear on it anywhere. A Bib topic querying this substitute gets nothing back and reads it as proof no award exists, which is how the Vietnamese corpus came to carry a note saying no judged award covered the topic. When a Bib matters, verify it another way and file it under guide.michelin.com regardless of which page you read it on.

top50gastropubs.com.name: Estrella Damm Top 50 Gastropubs
top50gastropubs.com.note: Annual ranked list with a year on it, published by William Reed. Ranks gastropubs overall, not any single dish.

hardens.com.name: Harden's
hardens.com.note: Reader survey at scale rather than a panel - dated and ranked, so tier A, but a different kind of judgement.

timeout.com.name: Time Out
timeout.com.note: OVER-REPRESENTED: 46 source records, the most of any domain. Frequently REPORTS other rankings rather than judging - check for syndication before counting.

designmynight.com.name: DesignMyNight
designmynight.com.note: 24 records. Listings-led with editorial on top; weaker than a masthead.

en.wikipedia.org.name: Wikipedia
en.wikipedia.org.note: Used for the Michelin star tables, which carry year-by-year history. Reference rather than recommendation - never counts as an opinion, only as an award record.

diffordsguide.com.name: Difford's Guide
diffordsguide.com.note: Drinks specialist with real depth - closer to tier A for bars.

visitlondon.com.name: Visit London
visitlondon.com.note: Official tourism board. 403s the fetcher but loads fine in a browser.

youtube.com.name: YouTube
youtube.com.note: Count per CHANNEL, not per video - a channel posting five London lists is one opinion.

reddit.com.name: Reddit
reddit.com.note: Count per THREAD. r/london, r/LondonFood, r/AskLondon, r/uklifestyle.

critmas.substack.com.name: Critmas
critmas.substack.com.note: First-person Substack - joins the queues and reports back. Exactly the kind of source the corpus was short of.

pickyglutton.com.name: The Picky Glutton
pickyglutton.com.note: Eats basically every dish, over multiple visits, before writing. The most rigorous independent reviewer in the corpus.

cheeseandbiscuits.com.name: Cheese and Biscuits
cheeseandbiscuits.com.note: Long-running independent London reviewer, famous for the restaurant tube map.

worldbeststeaks.com.name: World's 101 Best Steak Restaurants
worldbeststeaks.com.note: Annual ranked list of 101 restaurants with a year on it, running since 2019. Judged and dated, so tier A.

thefishandchipawards.com.name: National Fish and Chip Awards
thefishandchipawards.com.note: Run by the National Federation of Fish Friers, judged and dated, ceremony each February. The site publishes entry information rather than results - there is no winners page, and the 2026 shortlist has to be read from press reports. Attribute to this domain anyway: the award is the originator.

theworlds100bestcoffeeshops.com.name: The World's 100 Best Coffee Shops
theworlds100bestcoffeeshops.com.note: Ranked, dated, and re-run annually. The 2026 European edition assessed more than 5,300 cafes with a panel of 250 industry professionals and over 240,000 public votes, announced at World of Coffee Brussels in June 2026. The originator's own page serves the VOTING FORM rather than the results, so the London ranks were read from bean-here.com's report of them - the award is still the source, per the syndication rule.

londonbestcoffee.com.name: London's Best Coffee
londonbestcoffee.com.note: One-person specialist guide, edited by Dylan Cormack, based on independent visits. Rates out of 5. The front page shows a sample of a larger set behind a 'load more' control.

bean-here.com.name: Bean Here
bean-here.com.note: Specialist coffee blog. Used here only as the READER of the Europe's 100 Best ranking, not as a source in its own right - the citation belongs to the award.

thetimes.co.uk.name: The Times
thetimes.co.uk.note: National masthead with named critics. Giles Coren's Real Stars column reached this corpus through a TikTok post - the platform is not the publisher.

telegraph.co.uk.name: The Telegraph
telegraph.co.uk.note: PAID BOT LICENSING, NOT A PAYWALL. Confirmed 2026-09-09: every scripted request returns HTTP 402 Payment Required from Akamai with 'You are not authorized to access this content without a valid TollBit Token'. Not a UA problem - it reproduces with Chrome, Safari, Googlebot and no UA at all, so there is nothing to fix and it must not be worked around. The pages load normally in a browser; read one by hand and record it as such if a topic needs it.

nationalburgerawards.co.uk.name: National Burger Awards
nationalburgerawards.co.uk.note: Judged, dated, cook-off final run by Dine Out magazine. The site does not publish the results list, so finalists and winners are read from press reports - the AWARD is still the source, never the outlet that reported it.

broadsheet.com.name: Broadsheet London
broadsheet.com.note: Masthead with editors; London edition of the Australian title. Added 2026-09-03 for the hot pot pass (Angela Hui on malatang).

londoncheapo.com.name: London Cheapo
londoncheapo.com.note: Independent budget-London specialist. Refuses WebFetch with a 403 - read it with curl under a browser user agent.

honglingjin.co.uk.name: Red Scarf 红领巾
honglingjin.co.uk.note: Chinese-language UK guide for students and the diaspora. Publishes street addresses and per-head price bands, and runs an annual UK-wide readers poll - a community vote, NOT a judged panel, so tier C and never tier A. Scope any of its UK lists to London before counting (trap 12).

surreychinese.co.uk.name: Surrey Chinese 萨里鹿游器
surreychinese.co.uk.note: Chinese-language community site. Its London hot pot round-up is dated 2018 and its addresses have drifted - flag on recency.

uk002.com.name: UK002 英国生活零零兔
uk002.com.note: Chinese-language UK life site. Its London hot pot round-up is dated 2020 - flag on recency.

youtube.com/@dejashu.name: Shu (YouTube)
youtube.com/@dejashu.note: Also writes as Shu Lin. Quoted as a contributor inside Broadsheet London on the hot pot topic - counted there as Broadsheet, here as her own channel, because they are different publishers and name different venues.

youtube.com/@jayverified.name: Jay Verified (YouTube)
youtube.com/@jayverified.note: DECLINED on hot pot: description is venue marketing copy.

youtube.com/@ChinatownLondon.name: Chinatown London (YouTube)
youtube.com/@ChinatownLondon.note: The Chinatown estate promoting its own tenants. Tier F in substance - a landlord recommending its own restaurants is not evidence.

thecapturist.com.name: The Capturist
thecapturist.com.note: DECLINED on hot pot: photography courtesy of the venue, and framing near-identical to another blog three months later.

lardermag.co.uk.name: Larder Magazine
lardermag.co.uk.note: Returns HTTP 200 but the article body does not render to the fetcher - extraction yields site chrome only (trap 8). Read it in a browser.

friedchickenchampionships.co.uk.name: Fried Chicken Championships
friedchickenchampionships.co.uk.note: Inaugural January 2026, four judges scoring across five criteria. Results live at /fried-chicken-champions - /winners, /results, /awards, /judges, /shortlist and /finalists all 404, so a slug guess concludes no award exists.

wingfest.co.uk.name: Wing Fest
wingfest.co.uk.note: Judged since 2014, but it judges FESTIVAL TRADERS rather than London restaurants, and only wings. Scope hard before counting, and count Judge's Choice only - People's Choice is a crowd vote. London, Sheffield and Nottingham legs share one archive page.

thelondoneconomic.com.name: The London Economic
thelondoneconomic.com.note: Its fried chicken list is CHAINS ONLY by its own framing, ranked 1-11, July 2023.

starwinelist.com.name: Star Wine List of the Year UK
starwinelist.com.note: Awards WINE LISTS rather than wine bars, so it is restaurant-heavy and UK-wide. Scope to London AND to venues that pass the wine bar test before counting: of the 2026 UK Gold Stars, only Newcomer Wines is a wine bar and one winner is on the Isle of Wight.

london.camra.org.uk.name: CAMRA London Region
london.camra.org.uk.note: The Greater London region hub - links to all 13 branch sites. Not itself a Pub of the Year source; each branch judges its own.

pigsear.org.uk.name: CAMRA East London & City branch
pigsear.org.uk.note: Branch domain does not follow the camra.org.uk subdomain pattern. No Pub of the Year content found on this site as of Sep 2026 - a real gap, not a missed page.

swessex.camra.org.uk.name: CAMRA South West Essex branch
swessex.camra.org.uk.note: Domain currently redirects to an unrelated East Anglia regional page. No branch content reachable as of Sep 2026 - flag and recheck on a future pass rather than treat as permanently dead.

camraswl.org.uk.name: CAMRA South West London branch (old domain)
camraswl.org.uk.note: This domain has expired and now shows a registrar parking page. The branch's live site is swl.camra.org.uk - use that one. Left here so the dead domain is recognised rather than re-discovered as a new gap later.

swl.camra.org.uk.name: CAMRA South West London branch
swl.camra.org.uk.note: Live site, but its own Pub of the Year page was last updated March 2023 - treat any citation from it as stale unless a newer page is found.

youtube.com/@TheCraftBeerChannel.name: The Craft Beer Channel (YouTube)
youtube.com/@TheCraftBeerChannel.note: Jonny Garrett and Brad Evans's own channel and publishing imprint (two books). They also write ShortList's craft beer pieces, already registered under shortlist.com - counted there as ShortList, here as their own independent channel, per craft-beer-pubs.json's note on the distinction.

youtube.com/@realaleguide.name: Real Ale Craft Beer / Real Ale Guide (YouTube)

youtube.com/@BrewDogOfficial.name: BrewDog (YouTube, own site)
youtube.com/@BrewDogOfficial.note: The brand's own corporate channel. Tier F in substance whatever it recommends - a company recommending bars, even other people's, is not an independent opinion. DECLINED on craft-beer-pubs.

youtube.com/@SecretFoodTours.name: Secret Food Tours (YouTube, own site)
youtube.com/@SecretFoodTours.note: Advertising the company's own paid tour product, not an independent review - no venues named. DECLINED on craft-beer-pubs.

which.co.uk.name: Which?
which.co.uk.note: Member survey of UK hotel chains, dated and ranked. BRAND-LEVEL ONLY, UK-wide (Rob, 14 Sep 2026): never a claim about a London branch, and its average prices are national, not London. hotels-budget.

independent.co.uk.name: The Independent
independent.co.uk.note: National masthead. Its Gina Jackson budget-hotel list is recorded under cntraveller.com as one voice (hotels-budget).

cntravellerme.com.name: Conde Nast Traveller Middle East
cntravellerme.com.note: SYNDICATES CNT UK galleries ('A version of this article originally appeared on Conde Nast Traveller UK'). Resolve to cntraveller.com; never a second voice.

cntraveler.com.name: Conde Nast Traveler (US)
cntraveler.com.note: Carries CNT UK lists (e.g. Gina Jackson's cheap-hotels gallery under a US co-byline). Resolve to cntraveller.com; never a second voice.

mumsnet.com.name: Mumsnet
mumsnet.com.note: /articles/ pages are editor-compiled from Mumsnet Talk posts. /talk/ threads are tier E by nature but share this domain, so build-evidence counts article and threads as one voice at tier B - tally threads by hand.

thetimes.com.name: The Times
thetimes.com.note: Live Times URLs are thetimes.com; thetimes.co.uk is kept for older records. News UK 'Verifying Device' wall - read by hand. Giles Coren's Real Stars column reached one corpus through a TikTok post - the platform is not the publisher.

thehotelguru.com.name: The Hotel Guru
thehotelguru.com.note: Hotel-selection specialist. Cards show live 'from £X' rates with 'book online' and Booking.com comparison - check against the booking-engine rule (mrandmrssmith.com and i-escape.com are excluded in data/topics/hotels-budget.json).

eurocheapo.com.name: EuroCheapo
eurocheapo.com.note: Budget-hotel specialist with its own reviews (Tom Meyers). Stale pages (2014-2021) exist beside the current list.

loveandlondon.com.name: Love and London
loveandlondon.com.note: Real London blog (Jessica Dante). Several accommodation pages - one voice.

ontheluce.com.name: On the Luce
ontheluce.com.note: Lucy Dodsworth. Discloses hosted stays inline - check each page.

wanderingswithbri.com.name: Wanderings with Bri
wanderingswithbri.com.note: Real person, desk research ('50+ tabs open'), heavy affiliate linking.

holidayexpert.com.name: Holiday Expert
holidayexpert.com.note: Chelsea Dickenson (This Morning travel expert). Her social channels are the same voice.

lovinglondon.de.name: Loving London (Steffen)
lovinglondon.de.note: SAME AUTHOR as loving-travel.com - one voice across two domains, merge by hand (hostOf cannot see it). Affiliate-led.

loving-travel.com.name: Loving Travel (Steffen)
loving-travel.com.note: SAME AUTHOR as lovinglondon.de - one voice across two domains, merge by hand.

londontoolkit.com.name: London Toolkit
londontoolkit.com.note: Long-running visitor guide; hotel pages are booking-card selections with little visit evidence.

foreveroutofofficetravel.com.name: Forever Out of Office
foreveroutofofficetravel.com.note: Real person; desk research with Google review scores.

lovemytrips.com.name: Lovemytrips
lovemytrips.com.note: Desk byline ('lovemytrips_admin') over a real UK road-trip blog archive; its London hotel post shows no visit.

cheapfamilyholidays.co.uk.name: Cheap Family Holidays
cheapfamilyholidays.co.uk.note: Its Premier Inn page reads as generic AI-style copy with no evidence of a stay.

community.ricksteves.com.name: Rick Steves Travel Forum
community.ricksteves.com.note: Count per THREAD. build-evidence counts the domain once, so tally threads by hand.

excludedWhy.europeancoffeetrip.com: A DIRECTORY, not a selection. Its London page carries 204 cafes - close to every specialty coffee shop in the city - so it expresses no preference and naming a venue costs it nothing. Recording it would hand a citation to almost every venue in the corpus, and "named by two sources" would come to mean "in the directory, plus one real list". The same reasoning that bars a search-results page bars this.
excludedWhy.thatsup.co.uk: On the excluded list since the SERP-first rebuild, with the aggregators. Reason not recorded at the time; the company it keeps - OpenTable, TripAdvisor, Yelp, Viator, Klook - says listings-led rather than edited.
excludedWhy.lamplitlondon.com: AI SEO FARM (data/reference/hotel-corpus.md, 9 Sep 2026): 'The Lamplit Editors' desk byline, every guide the same 4-7 item length, raw keyword slugs beside written titles, complete grid coverage. Registered tier C by mistake; moved to excluded 14 Sep 2026. Still cited in data/consensus/markets.json.
excludedWhy.londonbest.uk: TEMPLATE FARM (data/topics/hotels-budget.json, 14 Sep 2026): six hotel pages all titled 'The 16 Best...', byline 'londonbestad', an identical 'Information and Reviews' subheading under every entry, keyword-phrased FAQs. Registered tier C by mistake; moved to excluded 14 Sep 2026. Still cited in data/consensus/cheap-eats.json and korean.json.
